name: @timmyjl12/pi-supervisor
description: A second observer built on @timmyjl12/pi-advisor: a live supervisor for pi and Oh My Pi that watches your session as it works and sends advice mid-run on its own model, with an operator-configurable status row instead of transcript/widget noise.
